notes: R30 000 salary plus a R5 000 fixed travel allowance (3701), business use below 80% (or not certified): 80% = R4 000 is remuneration (G21 p. 5). Taxable 34 000; x12 = 408 000; tax = 79 998 + 31% x (408 000 - 383 100) = 87 717; less 17 820 = 69 897; /12 = 5824.75. The calculator taxes the whole R5 000 (payeAnnualPayment.ts treats only 3605 and 39xx specially). UIF at the R177.12 ceiling either way; SDL on the allowance is not asserted.
